editorNote: Meta released Muse Spark as an open-weight multimodal model, and the follow-on coverage is the day’s main thread: Hugging Face, PyTorch, Nvidia and AWS all posted support, with Apple working on Mac performance. Nvidia also published its Nemotron 3.5 Super VL for agents. On the policy side, the FTC is reportedly probing Anthropic and OpenAI, and Anthropic is giving METR deeper access for evaluations.
